headline: Cloudflare CEO slams Vail Resorts’ Hornbuckle pick amid $500M Park City bid
summary: Vail Resorts (NYSE: MTN) announced on July 30, 2026 that Hornbuckle would join as its tenth board member, effective August 3, 2026.
